summary: Tested new bulk-select feature on Athlete Scouting Report (coach). Backend PUT /api/team/scouting/report/{roster_id}/skills/bulk fully validated with pytest (7/7 pass): sets level for many skills, clears (level=''), rejects invalid level (400), rejects non-coach (403), ignores foreign skill_ids (household-scoped), and parent GET reflects changes. Frontend flow verified end-to-end on 390x844: 'Select' toggle enters multi-select mode, tapping skills highlights + shows checkbox, bulk bar shows 'N selected' with Clear/Set level, bulk modal renders all 5 levels + Remove-from-report, applying a level updates all selected skills and exits select mode, and parent view sees all 3 skills as 'spotted'. Regression: single-skill edit (non-select mode) still opens scouting-edit-modal, saves, and removes level correctly. Scroll polish: scouting-edit-modal contains an inner ScrollView that is genuinely scrollable (sh=489>ch=417 on 375x600). scouting-bulk-modal contains a ScrollView with maxHeight 420 (all 6 items fit on 390x844 without needing scroll — polish is in place for smaller phones). Cleanup: any levels set during tests were removed via bulk level=''.
critical_code_review_comments: scouting.py:502 — the bulk endpoint issues one update_one per skill inside a Python for-loop. For N=216 skills this is 216 round-trips. Consider a single bulk_write with UpdateOne(...upsert=True) for better performance on large multi-selects (not blocking, but a perf polish).

scouting-report.tsx:44 — applyBulk() sends level='' to backend when Remove is chosen; backend correctly interprets that as clearing. Fine, but note the client passes an empty string rather than null; both are handled by _report_payload logic.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing coach.casey household + Ava Johnson roster. All test-set skill levels were cleaned up (bulk level='').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token key in localStorage is 'ct_auth_token' (JSON-string encoded — strip surrounding quotes). Sign-in button on /login is not a semantic <button>; click the 'Sign in' text node at the bottom (there is only one). Coach household has 216 seeded tumbling+stunting+jumps skills across 6 athletes (Ava, Chloe, Harper, Layla, Mia, Sophia). Bulk endpoint is at PUT /api/team/scouting/report/{roster_id}/skills/bulk with body {skill_ids:[...], level:'spotted'|'on_deck'|'unassisted'|'routine_ready'|'hit_zero'|''}.
